newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo names Antioco Taco Bell president.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo names Antioco Taco Bell president.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc. said Thursday it has named John Antioco as president and chief executive of its North American Taco Bell restaurant division.
The company said the unit, which includes 4,800 company-owned and franchised restaurants, has one of the strongest long-term growth records in the industry.

Antioco replaces John Martin, who will become chairman and chief executive of PepsiCo Casual Dining. Antioco most recently served as chairman and chief executive of Circle K Corp., one of the nation's largest convenience store chains.
